The 2022 Rolls-Royce Ghost is the most driver-focused sedan in the Rolls-Royce lineup. Its design follows what the brand calls Post Opulence: clean surfaces, superb materials and engineering that disappears into the background so that only the experience remains. This Ghost is finished in white over a vivid orange leather interior with black accents. It has the Starlight Headliner, the Illuminated Fascia, the Rear Theatre Configuration with seatback screens, and a blacked-out, custom-styled exterior that sets it apart from any other Ghost on the road.

Power comes from a twin-turbocharged 6.7-liter V12 engine (563 horsepower, 627 lb-ft of torque) that is paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission that drives all four wheels. Peak torque arrives at 1,600 4,250 rpm, so the Ghost moves with effortless, near-silent urgency at any speed. It runs from 0-60 Time4.6 Seconds to a top speed of 155 MPH. Rolls-Royce s satellite-aided transmission reads the road ahead and selects the right gear before each corner. All-wheel drive and all-wheel steering make this large sedan feel composed and agile, and the Planar suspension system with its forward-looking camera prepares for road imperfections before the wheels reach them. The result is the famous Rolls-Royce

The exterior has been reworked with an aggressive, modern look. A custom front bumper adds sharp intakes and black mesh lower grilles. The Pantheon grille, the Spirit of Ecstasy and the window surrounds are finished in black, contrasting with the white paint. A rear trunk lip spoiler, black rear diffuser and deep side skirts complete the stance. The car sits on black multi-spoke wheels with Rolls-Royce center caps, framing orange brake calipers that tie the exterior to the interior. Signature Rolls-Royce rear-hinged coach doors, laser-assisted LED headlights and slim LED taillights round out the design.

The interior is the standout of this car. Every seat, door panel and dashboard surface is wrapped in bright orange leather, set off by black piping, black upper accents, black carpeting and a black leather steering wheel. Piano Black veneer frames the dashboard. Across the passenger side of the fascia, the Illuminated Fascia glows with a field of stars and the GHOST nameplate. Overhead, the Starlight Headliner fills the black perforated leather roof with hundreds of fiber-optic stars. Rear passengers enjoy individual screens mounted in the front seatbacks, a fold-down center armrest with deployable cupholders and storage, dedicated rear climate controls and vents, and lounge-style seating with Rolls-Royce embroidered headrests.

Porsche Marin is proud to present this exceptionally equipped 2021 Porsche Taycan Turbo S finished in Chalk over a Black and Limestone Beige Leather Interior.

Powered by Porsches advanced all-electric powertrain paired with a two-speed transmission on the rear axle, the Taycan Turbo S delivers exhilarating acceleration, precise handling, and cutting-edge electric performance. As the flagship of the Taycan lineup, this Turbo S combines extraordinary performance capabilities with premium amenities and innovative technology, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a high-performance luxury sedan with unmistakable Porsche character.

The exterior features a sophisticated Chalk finish complemented by the SportDesign Front Fascia and wheels painted in High Gloss Black. LED-Matrix Design Headlights in Glacier Blue with Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus (PDLS+) provide advanced illumination while adding a distinctive visual signature. A Fixed Panoramic Roof in Glass enhances the cabins open, airy feel, while thermally and noise-insulated glass contributes to a quieter, more refined driving experience. Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB) with High Gloss Black calipers provide exceptional braking performance, while Porsche Dynamic Chassis Control Sport (PDCC Sport) enhances stability and cornering capability.

Inside, the cabin pairs a Black and Limestone Beige Leather Interior with a refined two-tone design. Ventilated Front Seats provide additional comfort, while Advanced Four-Zone Climate Control allows occupants to personalize their preferred temperature throughout the cabin. Illuminated Door-Sill Guards in Black Brushed Aluminum add a premium finishing touch, while the Storage Package provides additional everyday practicality. The Fixed Panoramic Roof and thermally and noise-insulated glass further enhance the interiors comfort and spacious atmosphere.

Technology and driver assistance features include Surround View, offering enhanced visibility when maneuvering in tight spaces, and Lane Change Assist, designed to help monitor surrounding traffic during lane changes. The Premium Package adds further convenience, while the Ionizer helps improve cabin air quality. For charging flexibility, the Mobile Charger Connect and 25-foot Charging Cable provide convenient at-home charging options.

Combining distinctive Chalk styling, an exceptionally capable all-electric powertrain, Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes, advanced chassis technology, and a luxurious two-tone leather interior, this 2021 Porsche Taycan Turbo S is an outstanding example of Porsche electric performance and innovation.

For more information or to schedule a private viewing, please contact zbeckner@porschemarin.com or visit us in person.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. 2026 Toyota Camry XSE: Refined Efficiency Meets Modern Style

The 2026 Toyota Camry XSE delivers a bold statement on the road with its stunning Wind Chill Pearl exterior and striking Cockpit Red leather interior. Engineered for drivers who demand both sophistication and sensible daily performance, this sedan balances sleek athletic design with exceptional real-world efficiency. Whether you are navigating your morning commute through Mesa or heading out on a weekend road trip, the Camry XSE brings responsive handling and elevated comfort to every mile. Explore our extensive selection of pre-owned sedans and crossovers or check out our full inventory of brand-new Toyota models to find your ideal vehicle today.

Performance & Capability

Beneath the sculpted hood of the 2026 Toyota Camry XSE lies a Dynamic Force 2.5L I-4 port/direct injection engine featuring dual VVT-iE/VVT-i variable valve control, delivering 184HP paired with an advanced CVT. Operating on regular unleaded fuel, this Front Wheel Drive sedan achieves an impressive EPA-estimated 47 MPG in the city and 45 MPG on the highway, making it an outstanding choice for efficiency-focused drivers. The sport-tuned suspension, featuring independent front struts and a multi-link rear suspension, works alongside gas-pressurized shock absorbers and front and rear anti-roll bars to provide a planted, confident ride through every turn. Driver-selectable drive modes allow you to tailor power delivery to match your driving mood, while electric power-assist speed-sensing steering ensures precise handling in tight spaces and relaxed cruising at highway speeds. For total peace of mind, 4-wheel ventilated front disc brakes with ABS and electronic brake assist deliver sharp, reliable stopping power.

Technology & Connectivity

Step inside the driver-centric cabin, where modern innovation seamlessly enhances every journey. The dashboard features two prominent displays, highlighted by a massive 12.3-inch primary touchscreen interface paired with a matching 12.3-inch full digital gauge cluster screen. Stay connected effortlessly with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smart device integration, alongside Bluetooth hands-free device connectivity and wireless audio streaming. Keep your phone charged and ready using the Qi-compatible wireless charging pad or any of the five strategically placed USB ports throughout the interior. Integrated navigation via Drive Connect keeps you on track with real-time route updates, while the built-in Drive Connect Intelligent Assistant provides intuitive voice activation so you can control audio and settings without taking your eyes off the road. Steering wheel-mounted controls put full command of the six-speaker audio system and full-speed range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control right at your fingertips.

Key Highlights

Experience the premium engineering and stand-out features that make this sedan exceptional.

  • Dynamic Force 2.5L Engine - Efficient 4-cylinder powertrain delivering 184HP.
  • 19-Inch Smoked Gray & Black Alloy Wheels - Premium wheels wrapped in P235/40R19 all-season tires.
  • Cockpit Red Leather Upholstery - Heated front sports seats with 8-way power adjustments and 2-way power driver lumbar support.
  • 12.3-Inch Touchscreen & Digital Cluster - Dual high-resolution displays for seamless navigation and vehicle metrics.
  • Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 - Driver assistance suite including Pre-Collision System, Lane Tracing Assist, and Road Sign Assist.
  • Qi-Compatible Wireless Charging - Convenient cord-free smart device charging.
  • Carpet Floor Mat Package - Includes carpet floor mats and a matching carpet trunk mat to keep the interior clean.
Visit Us Today

Visit us at Berge Toyota located at 2020 Riverview Auto Dr, Mesa, AZ 85201 to see this stunning sedan in person and take it for a test drive. Our team is ready to assist you with every step of the purchasing process. 2026 Toyota Crown XLE: Premium Efficiency and Executive Style

The 2026 Toyota Crown XLE elevates the executive sedan experience by pairing refined interior luxury with remarkable everyday efficiency. Draped in a sleek Storm Cloud exterior over a Black leather-trimmed interior, this elevated sedan offers high ride height, sophisticated styling, and an impressive EPA-estimated 42 MPG city and 41 MPG highway. Designed for drivers in Mesa seeking a quiet, comfortable daily commute, the Crown XLE provides a relaxed environment without sacrificing practical all-weather stability. Explore our inventory of new vehicles or browse our full selection of used vehicles to discover how this innovative flagship sedan transforms your daily drive.

Dynamic Hybrid Performance and All-Wheel Drive Confidence

Under the hood, the 2026 Toyota Crown XLE is powered by a 2.5L DOHC Dynamic Force 4-Cylinder Engine paired with a smooth continuously variable transmission (CVT). This advanced hybrid powertrain features an Engine Auto Stop-Start system to maximize fuel economy across both city streets and open highways. Delivering sure-footed confidence in all driving conditions, the Electronic Full-Time All-Wheel Drive system actively manages power distribution between the front and rear wheels. Driver selectable drivetrain modes allow you to customize throttle response to match your driving preference, while an independent strut front suspension and multi-link rear suspension work together to absorb road imperfections. Rolling on 19-inch multi-spoke machined-finish two-tone alloy wheels wrapped in 225/55R19 all-season tires, the Crown delivers a quiet, poised ride with predictable handling dynamics.

Advanced Cabin Technology and Intuitive Controls

Inside the cabin, the 2026 Toyota Crown XLE surrounds you with seamlessly integrated technology designed to keep you connected and focused. Front and center is a 12.3-inch primary display touchscreen accompanied by a matching 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster screen that provides clear vehicle telemetry at a glance. Wireless smart device integration via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto lets you access navigation, playlists, and communication apps without messy cords, while Qi-compatible wireless device charging keeps your smartphone powered up. Passengers throughout the vehicle benefit from five strategically placed USB ports, alongside Bluetooth wireless phone connectivity and audio streaming. The Intelligent Assistant built-in virtual assistant and voice activation allow for quick hands-free adjustments, while the HomeLink garage door transmitter brings added daily convenience to your driveway.

Key Highlights

The 2026 Toyota Crown XLE delivers a standout combination of elevated luxury, efficient hybrid engineering, and modern safety technology.

  • 2.5L 4-Cylinder Hybrid Engine - Offers smooth power delivery while achieving 42 city / 41 hwy MPG.
  • Electronic All-Wheel Drive - Provides full-time traction and stability across varied road conditions.
  • 19-Inch Two-Tone Alloy Wheels - Machined-finish aluminum wheels wrapped in all-season tires.
  • Heated and Ventilated Front Seats - 8-way power-adjustable leather seating tailored for year-round comfort.
  • 12.3-Inch Touchscreen Display - Features integrated navigation, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto.
  • Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 - Includes Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection and Dynamic Radar Cruise Control.
  • Blind Spot Monitor & Exit Warning - Enhances situational awareness with Safe Exit Alert and Rear Cross-Traffic Alert.
  • All-Weather Floor Liner Package - Includes durable weather-resistant floor liners and a protective trunk mat.
Visit Us at Berge Toyota

Experience the modern comfort and hybrid efficiency of the 2026 Toyota Crown XLE in person at Berge Toyota, located at 2020 Riverview Auto Dr, Mesa, AZ 85201. Our team is ready to walk you through every feature, help you get a fast trade evaluation on your current vehicle, or assist you to apply for financing online. Take the next step toward upgrading your commute by calling us directly at (480) 655-4400 or stopping by our showroom today. You can also get directions to Berge Toyota to plan your visit.

2026 Toyota Camry XSE: Refined Efficiency Meets Modern Sophistication

The 2026 Toyota Camry XSE delivers an exceptional blend of athletic style, advanced technology, and legendary reliability. Dressed in a sleek Underground exterior color paired with a bold Cockpit Red leather interior, this flagship sedan commands attention from every angle. Delivering an extraordinary EPA-estimated 47 city and 45 highway MPG, its efficient hybrid powertrain makes every daily commute through Mesa both economical and enjoyable. Designed for drivers who refuse to compromise on comfort or performance, this vehicle provides an elevated driving experience with premium seating, responsive handling, and high-tech cabin features. Whether you are searching for a stylish daily driver or an efficient highway cruiser, you can explore our pre-owned selection to see how this sedan stands out in its class.

Performance & Capability

Under the hood, the 2026 Toyota Camry XSE is powered by a Dynamic Force 2.5L I-4 engine featuring port and direct injection, DOHC, and VVT-iE/VVT-i variable valve control, producing a capable 184HP. Power is seamlessly delivered to the front wheels via an Electronically Controlled Continuously Variable Transmission (CVTi-S) with Front-Wheel Drive, giving you smooth acceleration across all driving conditions. The hybrid architecture integrates a high-efficiency lithium-ion traction battery and a hybrid starter generator alternator to maximize fuel economy without sacrificing responsiveness. Ride quality and driving dynamics are significantly enhanced by a Sport Tuned Suspension system featuring an independent Strut Front Suspension w/Coil Springs and a Multi-Link Rear Suspension w/Coil Springs. Drivers can tailor their experience using the Driver Selectable Drivetrain Modes, while gas-pressurized shock absorbers and front and rear anti-roll bars ensure planted stability. Finishing off the performance profile are 19-inch smoked gray and black-finished alloy wheels fitted with P235/40R19 all-season tires and front vented disc brakes for confident stopping power.

Technology & Connectivity

Inside the cabin, the 2026 Toyota Camry XSE surrounds you with cutting-edge infotainment and intuitive digital controls. The focal point of the dashboard is a massive 12.3-inch primary touchscreen display paired with a matching 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster that presents essential vehicle metrics in crisp detail. Stay seamlessly connected with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, allowing easy access to your favorite navigation apps, playlists, and hands-free calling. Built-in Drive Connect Intelligent Assistant provides voice-activated navigation and control, while Qi-compatible wireless device charging keeps your smartphone powered up without cluttering the center console with cables. Passenger convenience is further enhanced with five USB ports, SiriusXM satellite radio capability, and a HomeLink garage door transmitter integrated into the auto-dimming rearview mirror. Driver assistance technology includes Toyota Safety Sense 3.0, featuring Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, Lane Tracing Assist, and Road Sign Assist. If you are ready to upgrade your ride, take a moment to fill out an online credit application today.

Key Highlights

Experience the standout features built into this premium sport sedan.

  • Underground Exterior & Cockpit Red Interior - Striking color combination featuring leather front seat upholstery.
  • 19-Inch Smoked Gray & Black Alloy Wheels - Bold wheel design that enhances performance stance and curb appeal.
  • Dynamic Force 2.5L Hybrid Engine - Delivers 184HP with exceptional fuel efficiency of 47 city and 45 highway MPG.
  • 12.3-Inch Primary Touchscreen & Digital Cluster - Dual high-resolution displays for seamless control and driver feedback.
  • Qi-Compatible Wireless Device Charging - Convenient, clutter-free charging pad located in the front console.
  • Heated Leather Steering Wheel - Leather-wrapped steering wheel with heating function and integrated controls.
  • Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 - Active safety suite including Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection and Lane Departure Alert.
  • All-Weather Floor Liner Package - Includes durable all-weather floor liners and a protective trunk mat.
Visit Us at Berge Toyota

When you are ready to experience the 2026 Toyota Camry XSE in person, the team at Berge Toyota is here to assist. You can value your current trade-in online to see what your vehicle is worth, or visit our showroom located at 2020 Riverview Auto Dr, Mesa, AZ 85201. To learn more about this sedan, feel free to call our team directly at (480) 655-4400 or find directions to our dealership. You can also schedule a test drive or service appointment with our knowledgeable staff to get started today.

The 2026 Toyota Camry Nightshade delivers an exceptional balance of eye-catching design and everyday practicality. With an impressive EPA-estimated rating of 47 City and 45 Highway MPG, it is ideally tailored for maximizing fuel economy during daily drives across Mesa. Whether you are looking to upgrade your current commute or explore our selection of new vehicle inventory, this sleek sedan brings elevated comfort and reliable efficiency to every drive. Take a moment to browse our available pre-owned inventory to see how the Camry stands out from the competition.

Dynamic Performance and Engineering

Under the hood, the 2026 Toyota Camry Nightshade is powered by a Dynamic Force 2.5L I-4 port/direct injection, DOHC, VVT-iE/VVT-i variable valve control, regular gasoline, engine with 184HP. This advanced powertrain works seamlessly alongside an electronically controlled CVT and efficient Front-Wheel Drive system to provide smooth acceleration and remarkable efficiency. Built on a rigid platform featuring a Sport Tuned Suspension, Strut Front Suspension w/Coil Springs, and a Multi-Link Rear Suspension w/Coil Springs, the Camry offers crisp handling without sacrificing ride comfort. Power is balanced by Front Vented Discs and a regenerative braking setup, while driver-selectable drive modes allow you to tailor power delivery to match road conditions. Equipped with a Lithium Ion Traction Battery and a 13-gallon fuel tank, this sedan offers extended range for long journeys.

Advanced Technology and Cockpit Convenience

Inside the cabin, the Camry Nightshade offers an intuitive digital interface centered around the upgraded Multimedia Upgrade Package, which features a massive 12.3-in. Toyota Audio Multimedia Touchscreen. Driver information is clearly presented on a 7.00-inch digital gauge cluster display with ECO feedback monitoring. Smart device connectivity is standard thanks to Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring, supported by a Qi-compatible Wireless Charging pad and 5 USB ports distributed throughout the cabin. Convenience is further enhanced by the Convenience Package, which equips the vehicle with a Smart Key System On Front Doors and an Auto-Dimming Rearview Mirror w/HomeLink. Audio is delivered through a high-quality 6-speaker system, while Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 provides continuous driver assistance through features like Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control (DRCC) and Lane Tracing Assist (LTA).

Key Highlights

The 2026 Toyota Camry Nightshade features a impressive collection of factory equipment and distinct aesthetic details:

  • Nightshade Edition - Adds 19-inch satin black-finished alloy wheels, black bodyside inserts, black door handles, and a rear lip spoiler.
  • Dynamic Force 2.5L Engine - Delivers 184HP with fuel ratings of 47 City / 45 Hwy MPG.
  • SofTex Upholstery - Premium Black SofTex leatherette front seat upholstery with an 8-way power driver seat and power lumbar support.
  • Multimedia Upgrade Package - Includes a 12.3-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen with wireless smartphone integration.
  • Convenience Package - Features Smart Key proximity entry on front doors and an auto-dimming rearview mirror with HomeLink.
  • Power Tilt/Slide Moonroof - Lets natural sunlight and fresh air into the cabin at the touch of a button.
  • Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 - Active safety suite featuring Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection and Road Sign Assist.
  • Dual Zone Automatic Climate Control - Keeps front occupants comfortable with personalized temperature settings and rear seat air ducts.
